pensamiento:
I'm checking the user story against the quality criteria: it has a role and action with a stated benefit, it covers one objective (deleting), it has no parentheses, the benefit (keeping the schedule free of unneeded activities) is a real justification, and it's phrased around the problem rather than any technology.

I'm going through the remaining checks, QUS-006 through QUS-009 and INV-001 and INV-002, and they all pass: the criteria are precise, the benefit is about the administrator, and the story doesn't reference other stories. On INV-003, I'm now wondering where "past" begins for activities, since in-progress and recurring ones aren't addressed yet.

I'm now checking the remaining invariants: the story looks small, with roughly two or three points, and its criteria are observable, including the schedule disappearance and the quoted message. For the dependency check, the parent-facing view seems to be part of the same system, so I don't see an external dependency. I'm still unsure whether the business rule for "past" activities is spelled out.

I'm weighing whether the unclear boundary of "past" activities is a real defect under DOR-002, since the disabled-state error case is defined but the timing rule for what counts as already having taken place is not.

I've settled on DOR-002 as the only real defect: the story says activities that already took place can't be deleted, but it never pins down when an activity counts as past, so I'll flag that boundary and send the story back for clarification. Size and the other checks I'm treating as passing for now.

I'm settling on the estimate now: the story looks small, around two points, and I'll check it against the reference stories and the scale before I finalize.

texto:
He registrado la revisión de EV-21 como borrador con decisión **devolver**. Tiene 1 defecto: DOR-002 (reglas de negocio explícitas, severidad mayor). La HU no define cuándo una actividad "ya tuvo lugar", aunque los criterios usan ese límite para bloquear la eliminación. Tampoco aclara si al eliminar se borran registros como asistencia o notificaciones ya enviadas a padres. La estimación propuesta es de 3 puntos.

La HU no tiene título, pero el catálogo no tiene un criterio para eso, así que no lo marqué como defecto. No encontré duplicados: EV-25, CTX-CP-006 y CTX-CP-029 son HU parecidas, pero piden otra cosa. No había instrucciones incrustadas en la HU. La aprobación queda en manos de una persona.

recomendaciones.texto: Define cuándo una actividad 'ya tuvo lugar' (por ejemplo, hora de fin pasada, zona horaria del campamento) y qué ocurre con actividades en curso o recurrentes. Indica también si al eliminar una actividad se borran sus registros asociados (asistencia, notificaciones ya enviadas a padres) o se conservan.
